title: Cooked Extras
description: This mod adds more food and more cooked variants of vanilla food.
body:
![Title Thumbnail](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e78256a45d1f2548579bc49987251c48397409b.png)
### Available for:
[![Neoforge label](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a836f7c51f2b8c91b76be4cb8d5b24a4c859dc6a.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/cooked-extras/versions?l=neoforge)
[![Forge label](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69ef1252edfb54ffd2494d670db81801ae9c7a2f.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/cooked-extras/versions?l=forge)
[![Fabric label](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f88d61d699dbf81e53ab0f32d003405363375958_0.webp)](https://modrinth.com/mod/cooked-extras/versions?l=fabric)

This mod adds 4 different food items, some are cooked variants of vanilla food and some are new food items entirely. All the food items are made to give purpose to the items they are made out of, for example fried egg, it gives more reason to farm eggs.

## Showcase:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/hFVBfjaWEkI" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

<details>
<summary>Food</summary>

### Fried Egg
Fried egg can be made by either cooking a egg in a furnace / smoker or a campfire.
- 4 Nutritional value
- 0.4 Saturation

![Egg which is being smelted in furnace](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69b5ff81a21b6042252b4d1ec459ff1502179d63.png)

### Mushroom Skewer
Mushroom skewer can be made in crafting table by putting 1 stick, 1 brown mushroom and 1 red mushroom.
- 5 Nutritional value
- 0.5 Saturation

![1 stick, 1 brown mushroom and 1 red mushroom in a crafting table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47cbaeeb8b9120adbc3cf2f5759d7451a23db4d9.png)

### Toast
Toast can be made by either baking a bread in a furnace / smoker or a campfire.
- 6 Nutritional value
- 0.7 Saturation

![Bread which is being smelted in furnace](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70639bbfb4516f2d900c89b40cd2914e3118566e.png)

### Chocolate Sweet Berries
Chocolate sweet berries can be made by putting 1 sugar, 1 cocoa bean and 1 sweet berry in a crafting table
- 4 Nutritional value
- 0.6 Saturation

![1 Sugar, 1 cocoa bean and 1 sweet berry in a crafting table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f73418ea25f8e9c78e939cc82e8d8338fbf8883e.png)

</details>

This mod was made using MCreator and will not get updated regulary because i'm the only person working on it.
